demoted._declaration: Java partitions it: a field declaration and a local variable declaration are the same syntax in different places, so one alternation reachable from both a class body and a block makes every field ambiguous with every local. All nine members are concrete types occurring nowhere else, so nominal membership selects the same nodes the structural supertype would have.
